It can be used to filter points based on distance against shapes, lines or even other points. The filtered points can then be used as spawn positions for assets or as target points for relative position filtering. For example, the distance from walls, entrances or exits, windows, furniture could be written and filtered on room footprint sampled points to provide remaining areas in which more assets can be
